card.name: René “Loup” Arcemont: Party Animal X
card.text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card.

printing.flavor_text: Run wyld!

card.name: Wildcat Strike X
card.text:
Resolve 2 of the following of the Corpʼs choice:
- Gain 6[credit].
- Draw 4 cards.

printing.flavor_text: They can buy off union leadership, but they canʼt stop us walking out.

card.name: Carnivore X
card.text:
+2[mu]
Access, once per turn → **Trash 2 cards from your grip:** Trash the card you are accessing.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

printing.flavor_text:
“It hungers to sink teeth into problems!”
–Loup

card.name: Botulus X
card.text:
Install only on a piece of ice. *(If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.)*
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 2 virus counter on this program.
**Hosted virus counter:** Break 1 subroutine on host ice.

printing.flavor_text: Was it something you ate.

card.name: Buzzsaw X
card.text:
Interface → **2[credit]:** Break up to 2 **code gate** subroutines.
**3[credit]:** +1 strength.

printing.flavor_text: Destruction is an art!

card.name: Cleaver X
card.text:
Interface → **2[credit]:** Break up to 2 **barrier** subroutines.
**2[credit]:** +1 strength.

printing.flavor_text: Subtlety is a luxury!

card.name: Fermenter X
card.text:
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 2 virus counter on this program.
[click], [trash]**:** Gain 2[credit] for each hosted virus counter.

printing.flavor_text:
“Thereʼs a tension to a cook! Each processing cycle sweetens the pot and raises the heat. I stir all night, but few have my appetite for danger.”
–René “Loup” Arcemont

card.name: Leech X
card.text:
Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 2 virus counter on this program.
**Hosted virus counter:** The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.

printing.flavor_text: The greediest bloodsucker this side of a corporate boardroom!

card.name: Cookbook X
card.text: Whenever you install a **virus** program, you may place 2 virus counter on it.

printing.flavor_text:
“It waits on an unlabelled memstrip far below the deepest hab! Angry, desperate souls seek it out, hungry for power to change a brutal world. Once they can stomach no more bitter revenge, they return to that nameless tunnel, the book a recipe thicker.”
–Heinlein urban legend

card.name: Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler X
card.text: Once per turn → When a run on HQ or R&D ends, you may gain 2[credit] for each time you accessed a card during that run.

printing.flavor_text: I obtain your desire!

card.name: Mutual Favor X
card.text: Search your stack for 2 **icebreaker** and reveal it. *(Shuffle your stack after searching it.)* If you made a successful run this turn, you may install that program. If you do not, add it to your grip.

printing.flavor_text: The real reward is the friends you make along the way!

card.name: Tread Lightly X
card.text: Run any server. During that run, the rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 4[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“A mirrorfiber mod or high-end mantle can be helpful, but nothing beats a good dose of ‘keeping your damn head down.’”
–“G1ph3r” OʼRyan

card.name: Docklands Pass X
card.text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 2 additional card.

printing.flavor_text: Zahya knows the keeper of every door between the Docklands and the Domes! More importantly, she knows their price.

card.name: Pennyshaver X
card.text:
+2[mu]
Whenever you make a successful run, place 1[credit] on this hardware.
[click]**:** Place 1[credit] on this hardware, then take all credits from it.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

printing.flavor_text: “Braggarts chase big heists! Patience enriches skimming fractions of a credit at a time.” –Zahya

card.name: Carmen X
card.text:
If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 3[credit] less to install.
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 **sentry** subroutine.
**2[credit]:** +3 strength.

printing.flavor_text:
The whole wide world your domain
For law your own free will!

card.name: Marjanah X
card.text:
Interface → **3[credit]:** Break 1 **barrier** subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1[credit] less to use.
**1[credit]:** +1 strength.

printing.flavor_text:
“You canʼt rule a kingdom by standing still!”
–Zahya Sadeghi

card.name: Tranquilizer X
card.text:
Install only on a piece of ice. *(If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.)*
When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 2 virus counter on this program. Then, if there are 3 or more hosted virus counters, derez host ice.

printing.flavor_text: Shhhh! Itʼs naptime.

card.name: Red Team X
card.text:
When you install this resource, load 22[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
[click]**:** Run a central server you have not run this turn. If successful, take 3[credit] from this resource.

printing.flavor_text: The Domes of Heinlein are a pressure cooker of cutthroat capitalism! Prospective employers rarely have time for background checks.

card.name: Tāo Salonga: Telepresence Magician X
card.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may swap 3 installed pieces of ice.

printing.flavor_text: Sufficient skill is indistinguishable from magic!

card.name: Creative Commission X
card.text: Gain 6[credit]. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

printing.flavor_text: The challenge of my art is what I live for, but Iʼm not going to say no to a patron with taste!

card.name: VRcation X
card.text: Draw 5 cards. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

printing.flavor_text:
“You know thereʼs no water in the Sea of Tranquility, right.”
“That doesnʼt mean thereʼs no beach.”

card.name: DZMZ Optimizer X
card.text:
+2[mu]
The first program you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.

printing.flavor_text: Tāo exhaled, the med-exoskeleton faithfully stabilizing him! In that absent breath, he reached through layers of waldos and optimizers and plucked the errant molecule from the chip.

card.name: Pantograph X
card.text:
+2[mu]
Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1[credit]. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip.
Limit 1 **console** per player.

printing.flavor_text:
“With this beautiful baby I can juggle simultaneous runs by haptic feedback alone.”
–Tāo

card.name: Conduit X
card.text:
Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 2 virus counter on this program.
[click]**:** Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.

printing.flavor_text:
A dabbling with truth is a pernicious dream
Drink deep, or taste not the raw datastream!

card.name: Echelon X
card.text:
This program gets +2 strength for each installed **icebreaker** *(including this one)*.
Interface → **1[credit]:** Break 1 **sentry** subroutine.
**3[credit]:** +2 strength.

printing.flavor_text: The beauty of open projects—each stands atop past success!

card.name: Unity X
card.text:
Interface → **2[credit]:** Break 1 **code gate** subroutine.
**1[credit]:** +X strength. X is equal to the number of installed **icebreakers** *(including this one)*.

printing.flavor_text: The joy of handcrafted code—each fits perfectly within the whole!

card.name: Telework Contract X
card.text:
When you install this resource, load 8[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
Once per turn → [click]**:** Take 3[credit] from this resource.

printing.flavor_text:
“For all I know, I could spend a shift digging next to old Weyland himself!”
–Lane

card.name: Jailbreak X
card.text: Run HQ or R&D. If successful, draw 2 card and when you breach the attacked server, access 1 additional card.

printing.flavor_text:
“Weʼll take the access codes from their own prisec—privilege escalation through local application of force!”
–The Catalyst

card.name: Overclock X
card.text: Place 6[credit] on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.

printing.flavor_text:
“After 481FS4 started acting independently, all bets were off. Rethreading its own brain chip… even probing our nodes. I had to shut it down.”
–Linus Lovegood, NBN Novelties&Acquisitions

card.name: Sure Gamble X
card.text: Gain 8[credit].

printing.flavor_text: Anyone can put in the hours of planning, practice, and preparation–but making it all look like luck takes style!

card.name: T400 Memory Diamond X
card.text:
+2[mu]
You get +1 maximum hand size.

printing.flavor_text: LLDS still holds the patent, but good tech attracts knockoffs!

card.name: Mayfly X
card.text:
Interface → **2[credit]:** Break 1 subroutine. When this run ends, trash this program.
**1[credit]:** +1 strength.

printing.flavor_text: Compiling even the smallest AI takes weeks for only seconds of runtime, but that brief, shining moment allows… everything!

card.name: Smartware Distributor X
card.text:
[click]**:** Place 4[credit] on this resource.
When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.

printing.flavor_text: The beauty of 32nd-century tech: if it still functions after all these decades, you know the build quality is solid.

card.name: Verbal Plasticity X
card.text: The first time each turn you take the basic action to draw 2 card, instead draw 2 cards.

printing.flavor_text:
“Some kids got g-mods for beauty, sports, or staying up all night! My parents thought Broca-mods were cool. Hah. Fluent in ten languages so far, and still searching for the words to thank them.”
–Patrick Blue, Solar Artist

card.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design X
card.text:
You get +2 maximum hand size.
Whenever you score an agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

printing.flavor_text: Not an Atom Misplaced!

card.name: Luminal Transubstantiation X
card.text:
When you score this agenda, gain [click][click][click]. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
Limit 2 per deck.

printing.flavor_text: We are the light of tomorrow!

card.name: Nico Campaign X
card.text:
When you rez this asset, load 8[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 3[credit] from this asset.

printing.flavor_text:
“Haas thinks theyʼre making a new line of androgynous products! In truth, theyʼre making us thousands of new siblings to free.”
–Quetzal

card.name: Ansel 1.0 X
card.text:
**Lose [click]:** Break 2 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
[subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives.
[subroutine] The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

printing.flavor_text: Designed by 3018 European Champion Patrick Gower

card.name: Brân 1.0 X
card.text:
**Lose [click]:** Break 2 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
[subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

printing.flavor_text: A giant wakes….

card.name: Seamless Launch X
card.text: Place 3 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn.

printing.flavor_text:
“The first lesson for handling bioroids is simple: they must not be allowed to feel!”
–Do Nhi Minh

card.name: Sprint X
card.text: Draw 4 cards. Shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

printing.flavor_text: All time is crunch time!

card.name: Manegarm Skunkworks X
card.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend [click][click] or pay 6[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“Whose memory-tape needs such stringent security.”
–The Catalyst

card.name: Jinteki: Restoring Humanity X
card.text: When your discard phase ends, if there is a facedown card in Archives, gain 2[credit].

printing.flavor_text: An End to Suffering!

card.name: Longevity Serum X
card.text:
When you score this agenda, trash any number of cards from HQ. Shuffle up to 4 cards from Archives into R&D.
Limit 1 per deck.

printing.flavor_text: We make you anew!

card.name: Urtica Cipher X
card.text:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 3 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter.

printing.flavor_text: A novel spin-off of Chronos tech was admixing sensitive data with ethically-sourced brain images of injured staff! Few intruders can handle a thousand years of skin burns in one moment.

card.name: Diviner X
card.text: [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. If you trash a card this way with a printed play or install cost that is an odd number, end the run. *(0 is not odd.)*

printing.flavor_text: It reads your future in a single biometric sweep!

card.name: Karunā X
card.text:
[subroutine] Do 3 net damage. The Runner may jack out.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.

printing.flavor_text: You did not escape, you were shown mercy!

card.name: Hansei Review X
card.text: Gain 20[credit]. If there are any cards in HQ, trash 1 of them.

printing.flavor_text:
“Constant self-reflection is the key to excellence! We remember failed ideas, but do not carry them forward.”
–Director Kase, unknown leadership seminar

card.name: Neurospike X
card.text: Do X net damage, where X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on agendas you scored this turn!

printing.flavor_text: Macroscale developments within the Net decouple the prior informational states–surplus entropy is then gifted where it will do the most good!

card.name: Anoetic Void X
card.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 3[credit] and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

printing.flavor_text:
The self-evolving Net twists into spaces unthought and unthinkable: realms of gods and other infohazards, mocking our sacrifices to petty causality!
–Conceptual Frameworks for Applied Theology

card.name: NBN: Reality Plus X
card.text: The first time each turn the Runner takes a tag, gain 3[credit] or draw 2 cards.

printing.flavor_text: Why Settle for Real.

card.name: Tomorrowʼs Headline X
card.text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, give the Runner 2 tag.
Limit 1 per deck.

printing.flavor_text: We donʼt find news! We make it.

card.name: Spin Doctor X
card.text:
When you rez this asset, draw 3 cards.
**Remove this asset from the game:** Shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D.

printing.flavor_text: “Itʼs worse than dead meat—your project is too toxic to even feed to the vultures. If you don’t want to join it in the bloody memory hole, crawl onto every business show you can and wallow in blame like a pig in muck.”

card.name: Funhouse X
card.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, end the run unless the Runner takes 2 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“I might take a break from VR after this one!”
–SeaOfRibaldry, sensie streamer

card.name: Ping X
card.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 2 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.

printing.flavor_text:
AvID:??:83.174 time=0.632 ms
AvID:??:73.174 time=0.201 ms
AvID:??:73.174 time=0.000 ms ALERT

card.name: Predictive Planogram X
card.text:
Resolve 2 of the following. If the Runner is tagged, you may resolve both instead.
- Gain 3[credit].
- Draw 3 cards.

printing.flavor_text: For the best augmented reality shopping experience, please disable tracking protection!

card.name: Public Trail X
card.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Give the Runner 2 tag unless they pay 8[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“A runner uses significant resources scrubbing their traces! Every cycle, itʼs harder to pin them down. But the game changes. In Heinlein, no one can last a day without brushing our AR-network.”
–Cassie LaRosa, Lunar NetDefense Sysop

card.name: AMAZE Amusements X
card.text: Persistent → Whenever a run on this server ends, if the Runner stole any agendas during that run, give the Runner 3 tags. *(If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)*

printing.flavor_text: Free commemorative souvenir.

card.name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last X
card.text: Whenever you advance a card, gain 3[credit] if it had no advancement counters.

printing.flavor_text: Here to Stay!

card.name: Above the Law X
card.text:
When you score this agenda, you may trash 2 installed resource.
Limit 1 per deck.

printing.flavor_text: We are judge, jury, and executioner!

card.name: Clearinghouse X
card.text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 2 meat damage for each hosted advancement counter.

printing.flavor_text:
“First rule of the business: make sure youʼre not ‘personally liable’ when the transaction executes!”
–Ted J. Son, Central Counterparty Clearance

card.name: Ballista X
card.text: [subroutine] Trash 2 installed program or end the run.

printing.flavor_text:
“Puts a hole in your rig and your plans!”
–René “Loup” Arcemont

card.name: Pharos X
card.text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +6 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

card.name: Government Subsidy X
card.text: Gain 25[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“If the government spent 2% of the funding they provide us tracking where the other 99% went, my colleagues and I would be in prison…
…but that is a very big if.”
–Huey DeMora, W-Con public-private facilitation seminar

card.name: Retribution X
card.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash 2 installed program or piece of hardware.

printing.flavor_text: Did you really think youʼd get away with it.

card.name: Malapert Data Vault X
card.text: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 2 non-agenda card and reveal it. *(Shuffle R&D after searching it.)* Add that card to HQ.

printing.flavor_text: Sunlight does not touch the Crater of Eternal Darkness, a fitting abode for the Consortiumʼs malefic secrets!

card.name: Offworld Office X
card.text: When you score this agenda, gain 8[credit].

printing.flavor_text: As the first lunar city, Heinlein was built on the dreams of a new frontier and boundless opportunity, but He4 mining is too lucrative for the corps to ever relinquish control.

card.name: Orbital Superiority X
card.text: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 5 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

printing.flavor_text: Mobsters bribe police, megacorps acquire militaries!

card.name: Send a Message X
card.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 2 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.

printing.flavor_text: It might be over, but we will get them next time!

card.name: Superconducting Hub X
card.text:
When you score this agenda, you may draw 3 cards.
You get +2 maximum hand size.

printing.flavor_text: With Earth-Luna communications, saving microseconds returns megacredits!

card.name: Regolith Mining License X
card.text:
When you rez this asset, load 25[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
[click]**:** Take 3[credit] from this asset.

printing.flavor_text:
“The economy of three worlds is sustained by He4 extraction from the lunar surface. The very fulcrum of power, the key to collective survival—auctioned to the highest bidder.”
–The Catalyst

card.name: Palisade X
card.text:
While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +3 strength.
[subroutine] End the run.

printing.flavor_text: Keep the neighbors honest!

card.name: Tithe X
card.text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit].

printing.flavor_text:
“Youʼll give till it hurts… then itʼll reach for more!”
–Red Comyn

card.name: Whitespace X
card.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 4[credit].
[subroutine] If the Runner has 6[credit] or less, end the run.

printing.flavor_text: [this space intentionally left blank].

card.name: Hedge Fund X
card.text: Gain 8[credit].

printing.flavor_text: A financial instrument for diverting money from those outside to those inside!

card.name: The Catalyst: Convention Breaker X
card.text: Starter game only!

printing.flavor_text: Are you ready to start something big.

card.name: The Syndicate: Profit over Principle X
card.text: Starter game only!

printing.flavor_text: You work for us! You just donʼt know it yet.
